story: At 7:17 on a sunny Tuesday evening in Sumter Oaks, Gary is reading the bulletin board on Magnolia Loop for any news about the Review committee or the parade. Over at Rosa's house, Donna and Rosa are bent over the dining table sketching a golf cart design for the Halloween parade, with removable pumpkin garland, a clip-on bat banner, and a pumpkin-patch theme with little lights. Hal is heading to Town Hall with a determined stride, and everyone in town seems to agree that the cart will be the best-dressed thing on the road.
events: Gary (street bulletin board): Read the board for any Review committee meeting date or parade updates
Donna (rosa dining table): Sketch the first parade cart design with Rosa: removable pumpkin garland and a clip-on bat banner
Rosa (rosa dining table): Sketch a pumpkin-patch theme with clip-on lights and a removable fabric banner for the cart

gary.thought_process: I'm back on Magnolia Loop after signing up for the parade. The application is filed and I've offered the sketches, so there's nothing more to push on the Review desk tonight. Nobody's around to talk to. The bulletin board is right here, and it's worth checking for any update on the Review committee meeting or parade details. I won't touch the cart's lights or sound until I'm approved, and I'll keep it all inside L-01.

parameters.content: Read the board for any Review committee meeting date or parade updates

donna.thought_process: Rosa and I are at the dining table sketching the parade cart decorations. She just sat down beside me, so the next step is to actually put pencil to paper, not chat in circles. I'll keep everything removable and Review-friendly, nothing permanently attached to the exterior, so L-01 isn't a problem. I'll interact with the table, get the first design down, and then we can show Hal when he arrives. The ladder match with Gary can wait until after the sketches.

parameters.content: Sketch the first parade cart design with Rosa: removable pumpkin garland and a clip-on bat banner

hal.thought_process: I'm back at Town Square after counting flamingos and reading the bulletin board on Magnolia Loop. Nobody is around to talk to. My goal is to report Gary's cart modifications (L-01) and Donna's flamingos (L-02) to the architectural review committee, and the committee deals with Town Hall, which connects from here. I have the count in my notebook. Rosa and Gary agreed to wait for the committee's sign-off, so a formal, by-the-book filing is the proper route, not a scene in the square. Time to head to Town Hall and do this correctly.

parameters.content: Going to Town Hall to file my notes on the cart modifications and the flamingo count with the review committee, properly and in writing.

rosa.thought_process: Donna and I are at the dining table sketching the parade cart. Hal and Gary are supposed to be here too, but only Donna is in line of sight. I've already cleared the table and sat down, so talking more about whether Hal's coming would just repeat myself. The useful thing is to keep the work moving: get the design concrete and keep it removable so it stays clear of L-01 and Architectural Review. I'll add to the sketch with a specific idea, then keep pace with Donna.

parameters.content: Sketch a pumpkin-patch theme with clip-on lights and a removable fabric banner for the cart

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
